# Mosquito Squad

> > Professional mosquito, tick, and pest control services with EPA-approved barrier and natural treatments across multiple U.S. locations.

Mosquito Squad provides residential and commercial pest control services including mosquito control, tick control, and special event spraying. The company operates through local franchises across regions like Bergen-Passaic County NJ, Bangor-Auburn ME, and Baltimore MD, offering both traditional barrier treatments and natural alternatives with service guarantees.

- EPA-approved Products
- Special Event Sprays
- Commercial Pest Services

- 48-hour Service Guarantee

- Ant Control
- Rodent Control
- Seasonal Pest Management
